Select exactly 8 distinct field IDs from the supplied baseline variables for a classifier restricted to a few measurements. Rank the selected IDs by expected usefulness and complementarity for this task. Use only the measurement descriptions and task. Return JSON with the single key "order" containing the ordered field IDs. No patient records or labels are supplied.
{"task": "At treatment assignment in adults with HIV, estimate the risk of an AIDS-defining event or death in 180 days.", "fields": {"F4": {"description": "History of hemophilia", "name": "hemophil"}, "F5": {"description": "Karnofsky functional status score", "name": "karnof"}, "F3": {"description": "History of injection drug use", "name": "ivdrug"}, "F2": {"description": "Recorded race or ethnicity category", "name": "raceth"}, "F7": {"description": "Duration of previous zidovudine use in months", "name": "priorzdv"}, "F0": {"description": "Assigned treatment includes indinavir", "name": "tx"}, "F8": {"description": "Age in years", "name": "age"}, "F6": {"description": "Baseline CD4 cell count", "name": "cd4"}, "F1": {"description": "Recorded sex", "name": "sex"}}}
